title: Praxis contracted read models
description: One $def per contracted read model or profile message (READ-MODELS.md). Each record names its format; x-aiws-format and x-aiws-stability give the format a $def describes and its stability. Objects are open: a client ignores fields it does not know. The engine's own tests apply these definitions in strict mode, so every field the engine emits is declared here.

WorkflowCatalog.description: The workflow catalog list (GET /engine/workflow-catalog/v1): every template file in the host's template directory, with no readiness. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

WorkflowCatalogEntry.description: One template file. A file whose name breaks the template name rule, or that is not a regular NAME.json file, is listed under the name its file gives, INVALID and with no revision.

WorkflowTemplateDetail.description: One template's detail (GET /engine/workflow-catalog/v1/templates/NAME). For a VALID template, readiness, the binding review lines, the diagnostics and the template review digest come from the host's inspection run again for this request. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

templateDigest.description: SHA-256 of the template's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, or of its bytes when they are not JSON; null when the file was not read.

plan.description: The identity-free plan of a VALID template; null when INVALID.

requirements.description: The template's readiness requirements, an aiws-requirements/2 record (readiness.schema.json Requirements), or null.

readiness.description: Fresh readiness, an aiws-readiness/2 record (readiness.schema.json Report); null when INVALID or when the host could not inspect the agent.

runnable.description: VALID, with no error from the fresh review and readiness READY.

reviewDigest.description: The template review digest a creation request carries; null when INVALID or when no readiness binding could be made.

WorkflowRunRequest.description: A run creation request (POST /engine/workflow-runs/v1), a closed profile message the client sends; it names its format in profile. The host's parser refuses any other field. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

reviewDigest.description: The template review digest from the template's detail.

WorkflowRunResult.description: A created run: COMMITTED by this request, or REPLAYED from the receipt of an exact retry, with the original run. It carries no page address. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

revision.description: The work order's revision when the run was created.

status.description: The run's status when it was created, AWAITING_APPROVAL.

WorkflowRunError.description: A refused or uncertain creation. code is open: a client shows an unknown code with the requestId and acts on commitStatus. Only the fields a code carries are present. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

requestId.description: The request's id, or null when the body gave none the parser could read.

currentRevision.description: STALE_WORKFLOW_TEMPLATE only: the template's current revision.

reasons.description: READINESS_BLOCKED only: why the host's fresh review is not runnable.

blockingWorkOrderId.description: WORKFLOW_RUN_HELD and WORKFLOW_RUN_PENDING_APPROVAL only: the earlier open run of the template that needs a human first, the oldest such run by creation order.

reason.description: WORKFLOW_RUN_HELD only: HELD when that run is held or its scope has an open dispatch hold, UNRESOLVED_RESPONSIBILITY when it carries an attempt whose outcome is unresolved.

WorkflowRuns.description: A template's run list (GET /engine/workflow-catalog/v1/templates/NAME/runs?limit=N): the runs of every revision of that name, newest first by creation sequence, at most limit. WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES.md.

revision.description: The template revision the run was created from.

status.description: The run's coding status, as a read reports it.

held.description: The run is HELD or its scope has an open dispatch hold.

TemplateAssociation.description: A run's immutable association to the template it was created from.

reviewDigest.description: The template review digest the creation request carried.

RequestId.description: A lowercase UUID the client generates.

TemplateName.description: The template name rule: a lowercase letter, then at most 62 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and not a Windows reserved device name.

TemplateRevision.description: The template's current revision, from 1; null for a file whose name breaks the rule or that was not read.

code.description: Open: a client shows an unknown code with its message.

TemplatePlan.description: A guided-authoring coding plan without workOrderId and runId.

LedgerAmount.description: An exact integer in the ledger cost unit, as a string.
